first_actions_scope: Untimed synthetic observation for numerical inspection only; not a task-success measurement.

execution_mode.scope: Read-only native implicit-plan getter, queried outside timing; null means the runtime does not expose it.

telemetry.scope: Whole selected GPU during timing phase, including input preparation; not isolated process power/VRAM.
telemetry.device_mapping: nvidia-smi device selection is explicit and may differ from CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES remapping.

gpu_identity.stdout: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 Laptop GPU, GPU-64aae36b-ef77-b0d4-b1c7-f7ab17a729f1, 610.74, 24463

packed_identity.note: Engine retains BF16 source weights; artifact bytes are not measured VRAM savings.

runtime_identity.limitation: Imported SO hash is authoritative. Workspace Rust hashes record inspected source, not a proof that this SO was compiled from those exact files; retain build provenance separately.

timing_scope.model_ms: Blocking native model call through host float32 action return; includes native input transfers, GPU work, synchronization and D2H.
timing_scope.total_ms: Policy internal preprocessing/tokenization, blocking native model, postprocessing/decoding; no simulator or network.
timing_scope.wrapper_ms: External perf_counter around policy.infer; input construction and additional finite checks excluded.
timing_scope.synchronization: Native binding returns completed host f32 arrays. Inspected pi05 host-return transfer and GR00T executor synchronize CUDA before D2H. These are wall-clock API times, not CUDA-event kernel times.
timing_scope.limitation: Cross-library input/tokenization/precision paths differ; report separately, not as a matched end-to-end speedup.

input_contract.prompt: put the moka pot on the stove
